claims.claim: Flexbox is a one-dimensional layout model that distributes space and offers alignment capabilities.
Setting display:flex establishes a flex container and its direct children become flex items.
flex-direction establishes the main axis and the cross axis is perpendicular to it.
The initial flex-item values include flex-grow:0, flex-shrink:1, and flex-basis:auto; the container's initial align-items value is stretch.
Positive flex-grow factors allocate available positive free space proportionally, while flex-shrink is used when room is insufficient.
justify-content acts on the main axis and align-items acts on the cross axis.
With three 160px bases in 720px and grow factors 2,1,1, positive free space is 240px and the resulting simplified allocation is 280px, 220px, 220px.
